meaning: Construct two Ontic/frame pairs with actual Bool→ZFSet interpretation ∅/{∅}. The nominalist-style profile preserves an existing located bearer and mathematical membership while set entities are absent/unlocated; its unlocation reuses the certified induction theorem. The forward-only model has both set entities existing and located, retains member-to-set propagation and explicitly violates reverse support at the empty-set representative. These reject only the inference from forward propagation alone, not any preferred worldview.
